messages:
jas: FYI APAC onboarding stalls started ~02:05 local after the subnet microsegmentationpolicy rolled. nodes can reach metadata but keystore decrypts failing.
rebecca: error from node bootstrap: `Failed to decrypt instance-key: AccessDenied on kms:Decrypt`
chen: Is this the new VPC endpoint policy we pushed that denies kms:Decrypt for cross-account keys?
jas: yes, policy tightened to only allow specific roles via principal condition. thought it would only affect control-plane.
infra-bot: policy-change applied at 02:00 by rebecca (change-id: net/apac-seg-202).
paul: consequence: cloudwatch agent can't push logs to central account (PutLogEvents 403) -> bootstrap healthcheck fails -> node marked unhealthy by autoscaler.
anya: we also see rising NAT gateway bytes as some retries fallback to public egress from older subnets. cost alert started at 02:30.
rebecca: we should avoid a full open egress rollback. Proposal: allow kms:Decrypt for `arn:aws:iam::111222333444:role/apac-keystore-uploader` and allow s3:PutObject on the audit bucket from the uploader role via endpoint policy. Keep default-deny otherwise.
chen: that sounds good. endpoint policy change keeps traffic on privatelink and avoids increasing NAT egress.
jas: compliance note: need an audit trail of any temporary exceptions and TTL for the exception (max 2 hours) with tags for approver.
paul: quick validation: bootstrap script uses the role `apac-node-bootstrap`. can we test from a staging node?
rebecca: running a staging canary now: `aws --region ap-southeast-1 kms decrypt --ciphertext-blob fileb://blob.enc --key-id alias/apac-keystore --profile staging-node`
infra-bot: canary test started at 02:12 by rebecca.
rebecca: canary failed before change. updating endpoint policy to add the role condition and retry. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/5987 (includes policy + rollback TTL)
jas: applied change. staging canary decrypt now OK. logs delivered.
paul: confirmed new nodes in canary ASG now reach healthy state and register to pool. autoscaler drain reduced.
anya: cost note recorded: avoiding NAT egress estimated saved ~$120/day for this surge window. filed cost ticket COST-775.
jas: next steps:
- merge PR with 2hr TTL on exception and approver metadata
- run controlled rollout to prod uploader endpoint policy
- schedule postmortem and add endpoint-exception TTL to runbook
rebecca: added runbook TODO in infra docs and pinged security for signoff. @anya please escalate if finance wants different tagging.
infra-bot: change-merge completed and exception will auto-revert at 04:15.
chen: good call keeping traffic on the endpoint. avoids cross-account KMS exposure and large NAT bills.
jas: closing after autoscaler steady for 20m. will open a separate thread for the postmortem writeup. :white_check_mark:
